global_warning: These are bounded internal experiments, not independent replication and not evidence of consciousness or unrestricted general intelligence. Open each evidence file for its exact protocol and scope.

claims.title: Official recurrent causal-policy promotion
claims.headline: 61/64 fresh sealed success; all engine gates passed; 48/48 retention
metrics: Atomic engine promotion; Lesson 4 is next
claims.scope: Official recurrent-track promotion for the bounded anonymous-controls lesson. The track inherited two previously verified Object Laboratory lessons, used the unchanged public-trained recurrent policy, and excluded all previously revealed sealed seeds. The environment, reward, confidence calculation, and evaluation protocol remain engineered. No unrestricted causal-reasoning claim.

claims.title: Symmetry-aware recurrent causal-policy confirmation
claims.headline: 64/64 fresh sealed success with honest initial uncertainty and 0% post-evidence uncertainty
claims.scope: Supplemental qualification under a versioned uncertainty protocol. The rule was publicly validated and source-frozen before new seeds were drawn, and all 160 previously revealed sealed seeds were excluded. The frozen recurrent policy learned the action strategy; the environment, reward, confidence calculation, and evaluation protocol remain engineered. This did not mutate the official promoted workspace, and the earlier failed confirmation remains preserved.

claims.title: Recurrent causal-policy sealed confirmation
claims.headline: 64/64 causal success and 48/48 retention, but the uncertainty-rate gate failed
claims.scope: Supplemental sealed confirmation of the integrated cumulative candidate. Behavioral performance, retention, controls, integrity, resources, input boundary, and replay passed. Formal qualification failed because the entropy-based metric counts the unavoidable first intervention among symmetric controls as uncertain. The promoted workspace was not mutated and the revealed seeds were not reused.

claims.title: GUM School third sealed examination
claims.headline: 32/32 trained versus 6/32 before training and fresh; prior lessons retained at 48/48
claims.scope: Official pass for the first narrow Causal Workshop lesson. Intervention scheduling is engineered; the reusable probe-then-repeat strategy is activated through reward and each anonymous control is grounded from its observed consequence. No open-ended causal-reasoning claim.

claims.title: Causal intervention scaffold ablation
claims.headline: Without the engineered intervention schedule: 4/64 retained and 10/64 after the full retraining budget
claims.scope: Negative result using public curriculum seeds only. The current learner did not invent a general intervention policy when the probe-then-repeat scheduler was removed. This narrows the third sealed pass to scaffolded control grounding.

claims.title: Reward-grounded recurrent causal-policy experiment
claims.headline: 439/512 learned versus 38/512 random and 32/512 untrained under an 11-action cap
metrics: No event labels, tried-action mask, probe order, or repeat rule
claims.scope: Development-only pass. A permutation-equivariant recurrent policy with scalar-reward self-imitation met the 80% success and 65% Wilson-lower-bound gates. Iterative development informed the final generic sampling temperature, so this is not sealed confirmation or an official promotion; no sealed cases were used.

claims.title: GUM School second sealed examination
claims.headline: 32/32 trained versus 14/32 before training and fresh; Lesson 1 retained at 24/24
claims.scope: Official pass for the second narrow Object Laboratory lesson. Pixel parsing and active probing are engineered; appearance-to-identity and anonymous output mappings are learned from scalar reward. No causal-school or general-intelligence claim.

claims.title: GUM School first sealed examination
claims.headline: 32/32 frozen swarm versus 0/32 fresh and 14/32 random; all seven gates passed
claims.scope: Official pass for the first narrow Object Laboratory lesson only. Pixel tracking remains engineered; anonymous action mapping is learned. No later-school or cross-family claim.

claims.title: GUM School training-lane rehearsal
claims.headline: 32/32 trained swarm versus 0/32 fresh; candidate safely quarantined
claims.scope: Public development-only rehearsal of the first lesson. Pixel tracking is engineered; anonymous action values are learned. Not sealed evidence or an official promotion.

claims.title: Concepts, skills, and transfer
claims.headline: 20/20 held-out transfer; 1,230.59× experienced-vs-blank advantage
claims.scope: Synthetic pixel worlds with anonymous actions. Not arbitrary natural environments.

claims.title: Autonomous concept-count selection
claims.headline: Five event concepts selected; 20/20 transfer; 498.06× advantage
claims.scope: Structured rendered events; the changed-pixel and clustering biases remain engineered.

claims.title: Real-file data rescue
claims.headline: 5/5 unfamiliar JSONL files repaired; 348× experience advantage
metrics: Validator used only for scalar feedback
claims.scope: A bounded JSONL repair family, not arbitrary office work.

claims.title: Learning-to-learn
claims.headline: Median 2.30× and mean 4.48× held-out speedup across five minds
metrics: Four of five improved; one regressed to 0.90×
claims.scope: A learned three-number acquisition policy within the tested task distribution.
